test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Swadesh Darshan Scheme (SDS) which was launched in 2014-15 by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, has been revamped as ______________ in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadesh Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swadesh Darshan Scheme (SDS)** was launched in **2014-15** by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India.
 
• Its primary aim is to develop **theme-based tourist circuits** in the country.
 
• In **2023**, it was revamped as **Swadesh Darshan 2.0 (SD2.0)**.
 
• This scheme focuses on the **integrated development** of tourist circuits around specific themes.
 
• SD2.0 aims to enhance the overall tourist experience, improve infrastructure, and promote local handicrafts, culture, and cuisine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Key Initiative
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Integrated Development
 Focuses on developing and promoting all aspects of a tourist circuit, including infrastructure, attractions, and services.
 
 

 Theme-based Circuits
 Development based on specific themes such as heritage, culture, spirituality, and ecotourism to attract tourists with varied interests.
 
 

 Sustainability
 Emphasizes sustainable and responsible tourism practices to preserve the environment and local culture.
 
 

 Public-Private Partnership
 Encourages collaboration between the government and private sector to boost investment and innovation in tourism infrastructure.
 
 

 Boost to Local Economy
 Promotes local handicrafts, cuisines, and cultures, thereby providing economic benefits to the local communities.
